# @trysac/mcp-server-template

> Hardened TypeScript MCP server template: zod tool schemas, Streamable HTTP on localhost with Origin checks, bearer tokens, size and rate limits, timeouts and tests. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example and API summary
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files and coverage
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defended and not defended threats
- [Decisions](docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): architecture decision records

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, timeline and effort metrics
